opening.argument: The presentation ties participation to a $99 payment and unit purchase, stating, "Get your 99 get a unit purchased" and that without completing the 99 step there is "no way to place you." It then describes placement in a binary structure, instructs placed participants to place teammates, and displays a branching diagram with left and right teams. The speaker also says, "And then I was able to transfer those Bitcoins over to BitClub Network," connecting Bitcoin transfers to the named program and external destination. These features support recruitment through team placement and tiered positions, while the material does not establish recipient ownership, a completed viewer transaction, financial loss, or the truth of the program's claims.
